# Lundburgerr's 0.5 Shield Wall Smith Leaguestarter — author text (extracted 2026-09-30)

variants (order, id): default-variant "Act 1 - Rolling slam/Boneshatter"; 3 "Act 2 Before lvl 22 - Rolling slam/Boneshatter"; 2 "Act 2 - Shield Wall Swap"; 4 "Act 3"; 5 "Act 4"; 6 "Interludes"; 7 "Maps"; 8 "Giga Endgame"
Rich text widgets "How it Works" and "Changelog" are empty.

## Build Overview
Contrary to popular belief, Shield Wall didn't actually get nerfed that much this league and is still going to be one of the strongest league starts, and arguably the best league start because of how extremely simple it is to gear in maps. In 0.2, 0.3 and 0.4, there have been a Smith of Kitava at the very top of the XP ladder the first few days (In 0.2 it was me :)).
The base damage nerfed on shield wall and fortifying cry was simply to compensate for the base armour buff on Shields. We will however do around 30% less damage at worst case against single target in endgame due to the Fortifying Cry changes which prevents it from shotgunning.
But Shield Wall was already exceptionally strong in 0.4 and the strongest build during the first weekend of the league. It was obliterating bosses already so a 30% nerf for single target might be warranted.
**PASSIVE TREE CHANGES IN 0.5**
For the be most part, just use the same tree as listed here for the 0.4 tree. If you want to try something new, grab vaal pact and the leech nodes that gives attack speed while leeching, these could be very strong. Note that instant life flasks should still work with Vaal pact (not tested), so an Olroth flask is very good if you go vaal pact.
**REGEX:**
to.att|speed|melee|leech|tower|Leech

## How it Plays
**When clearing:** Drop Shield Wall and either use a warcry or Shield Charge. Once you get to endgame, the more you can use Shield Charge, the faster your map clear is.
**Against bosses**:
1. Freezing mark (can be skipped after you get armour break from other sources)
2. Place Totem
3. Infernal Cry + Fortifying Cry (When you get it)
4. Spam Shield Wall
5. Sunder after armour is broken (When you get Sunder)
6. Repeat

## Strengths
- Easy to cap resistances in campaign and end game due to Smith of Kitava Ascendency
- Very tanky in campaign after you ascend the first time
- Screen wide clear with the endgame setup
- Can immediately start stacking rarity on gear when you reach maps because of how easy it is to max your resistances
- Can do all content and bosses very early on league start
## Weaknesses
- Main skills not accessible until lvl 22
- Damage and clear does not scale as hard when you get giga juiced gear compared to other builds. Might want to consider a second build to swap into once you farmed initial currency. Typically after one week depending on how much you play

=== VARIANT default-variant | Act 1 - Rolling slam/Boneshatter
[SkillGems] Keep your ⟦Rolling Slam⟧ at lvl 1! If you're forced to upgrade your ⟦Rolling Slam⟧, make sure to keep the lvl 1 copy and don't upgrade it. If you need more stun buildup to prime enemies for stun for ⟦Boneshatter⟧, you can always cut ⟦Brink I⟧ in act 1 in next league.
Support gem priority
1. ⟦Impact Shockwave⟧ (⟦Boneshatter⟧)
2. ⟦Concentrated Area⟧ (⟦Mace Strike⟧)
3. ⟦Fire Attunement⟧ (⟦Mace Strike⟧)
4. ⟦Magnified Area I⟧ (⟦Boneshatter⟧)
5. ⟦Tireless⟧ (⟦Infernal Cry⟧)
6. ⟦Window of Opportunity I⟧ (⟦Perfect Strike⟧)
7. ⟦Magnified Area I⟧ (⟦Herald of Ash⟧)
8. ⟦Rapid Attacks I⟧ (⟦Rolling Slam⟧)
Optional. ⟦Brink I⟧ (⟦Rolling Slam⟧)
If you have too high damage or stun build up, ⟦Rolling Slam⟧ might stun the enemies immediately which you don't want. You just want to have enough stun buildup so that you can proc the shockwave on ⟦Boneshatter⟧. Enemies will have a white glowing orb on them when they have just the right amount of Stun buildup.
When you get ⟦Perfect Strike⟧ move ⟦Concentrated Area⟧ from ⟦Mace Strike⟧ to ⟦Perfect Strike⟧. If you have issues timing and hitting with your ⟦Perfect Strike⟧ on bosses, you can slot in either ⟦Fire Attunement⟧ or ⟦Rapid Attacks I⟧ (Or both) instead of ⟦Window of Opportunity I⟧ or ⟦Concentrated Area⟧.

=== VARIANT 3 | Act 2 Before lvl 22 - Rolling slam/Boneshatter
[SkillGems] **T2 support gems should be cut in this order:**
1. ⟦Raging Cry⟧ (⟦Infernal Cry⟧)
2. ⟦Urgent Totems I⟧ (⟦Shockwave Totem⟧)
3. ⟦Mark for Death⟧ (⟦Freezing Mark⟧)
4. ⟦Mark of Siphoning⟧ (⟦Freezing Mark⟧)
5. ⟦Raging Cry⟧ (⟦Fortifying Cry⟧, used in Act 3)
Optional. ⟦Hardy Totems I⟧ (⟦Shockwave Totem⟧)
**Optional:** If you are running a talisman on your swap, you may cut ⟦Ferocious Roar⟧ if you want. After you get ⟦Fortifying Cry⟧ you can slot ⟦Infernal Cry⟧ into ⟦Ferocious Roar⟧. You can also use ⟦Pounce⟧ instead of ⟦Freezing Mark⟧.
⟦Shockwave Totem⟧ will not be used until you get ⟦Shield Wall⟧, but it is a good idea to use a lvl 6 Skill gem to cut ⟦Shockwave Totem⟧. You get one guaranteed from the boss in Mawdun Mines.

=== VARIANT 2 | Act 2 - Shield Wall Swap
[Equipment] (EQ_NOTE — identical text repeated in Act 3, Act 4, Interludes)
On one handed maces you are looking for + to melee skills, it's normal to not get one because they are little bit rare.
On Gloves you are looking for flat damage, attack speed, +melee levels and leech. Typically you will only have gloves with 1 or 2 good mods.
On rings you want resistances, flat damage and leech.
Make sure you pick up any normal rarity body armour (ideally strength absed of course) as soon as you enter Act 2. We wanna make sure we have this after we ascend.
Make sure to use armourer scraps on your shield, you get most of them back if you salvage the shield when you find an upgrade. Every 5% quality will give you one armourer scrap from salvage.
[SkillGems] There is probably a guaranteed lesser jewelers orb from the league mechanic in Buried Shrines, use that on Shield Wall.
**T2 support gems should be cut in this order:** (same list 1-5 + optional Hardy Totems I as Act 2 Before lvl 22)
**Optional:** If you are running a talisman on your swap, you may cut ⟦Ferocious Roar⟧ if you want. After you get ⟦Fortifying Cry⟧ you can slot ⟦Infernal Cry⟧ into ⟦Ferocious Roar⟧
⟦Leap Slam⟧ is only used as a movement ability, you don't really need it.
**IMPORTANT:** (WARCRY_NOTE — repeated in every later variant) Make sure that that the warcries are on weapon set 2 (assuming you allocated the warcry nodes on weapon set 2) and everything else is on weapon set 1.
[PassiveTree] The three strongest ascendency noteables early on is:
* Molten Symbol (25% of fire damage taken as physical)
* Flowing Metal (50% of Armour applies to elemental damage)
* Tantalum Alloy (75% fire resistance)
You can basically grab any combination of 2 of these, you will be very tanky.

=== VARIANT 4 | Act 3
[Equipment] EQ_NOTE
[SkillGems] Guaranteed lesser jewelers orb in Sandswept marsh, At the end of the zone there is a small area with 2 rare monsters and a chest. Kill the rares and loot the chest for the lesser jewelers orb, save it for Fortifying cry.
You will first cut ⟦Fortifying Cry⟧ then ⟦Sunder⟧ from your first two lvl 9+ skill gems.
Your skill slots will be full, so you can slot out ⟦Leap Slam⟧ temporarily until we can remove ⟦Freezing Mark⟧ in Act 4.
**T3 support gems should be cut in this order:**
If you don't already have extra of these supports, cut them for ⟦Fortifying Cry⟧: 1. ⟦Raging Cry⟧ 2. ⟦Fire Attunement⟧
Then cut these:
1. ⟦Close Combat I⟧ (For ⟦Fortifying Cry⟧)
2. ⟦Magnified Area II⟧ (⟦Shield Wall⟧)
3. ⟦Magnified Area II⟧ (⟦Herald of Ash⟧)
4. ⟦Prolonged Duration II⟧ (⟦Sunder⟧)
5. ⟦Rapid Attacks I⟧ (⟦Sunder⟧)
6. ⟦Font of Mana⟧ (⟦Shockwave Totem⟧), ⟦Prolonged Duration II⟧ if you already have mana leech on gear.
If you drop extra lesser jewelers orbs, put it on ⟦Shockwave Totem⟧ and then ⟦Infernal Cry⟧ first.
**Spirit gems:** After killing the boss in Azak you will get 30 extra spirit. You can either cut ⟦Attrition⟧ or ⟦War Banner⟧, your choice. War Banner is typically more damage on bosses but it means you have to actively put down a banner.
WARCRY_NOTE
[PassiveTree] Ascending in Act 3 is optional, it will significantly improve your defenses. But Shield wall warrior is strong enough to skip this and just get the second and third ascend at the same time when doing a lvl 60 Barya. You are guaranteed to drop a lvl 60 Barya in Interlude 2 from the boss in Sel Khari Sanctuary.

=== VARIANT 5 | Act 4
[Equipment] EQ_NOTE
[SkillGems] Guaranteed Greater jewelers orb from the league mechanic in Ngakanu, use this on ⟦Shield Wall⟧
T4 support gems should be cut in this order:
1. ⟦Enraged Warcry I⟧ (⟦Fortifying Cry⟧, remove ⟦Close Combat I⟧)
2. ⟦Armour Break III⟧ (⟦Shield Wall⟧, after you get Greater jewelers orb, now you don't need ⟦Freezing Mark⟧ anymore)
3. ⟦Impale⟧ (⟦Shield Wall⟧, instead of ⟦Fire Attunement⟧ or whatever you have there)
3. ⟦Rapid Attacks II⟧ (⟦Shield Wall⟧)
4. ⟦Urgent Totems III⟧ (⟦Shockwave Totem⟧)
5. ⟦Hardy Totems II⟧ (⟦Shockwave Totem⟧)
Optional: ⟦Rapid Attacks II⟧ (⟦Sunder⟧); ⟦Rapid Attacks II⟧ (⟦Leap Slam⟧); ⟦Cooldown Recovery II⟧ (For ⟦Infernal Cry⟧ if you get an extra lesser jewelers)
WARCRY_NOTE

=== VARIANT 6 | Interludes
[Equipment] EQ_NOTE
[SkillGems] T5 support gems should be cut in this order:
1. ⟦Enraged Warcry II⟧ (Replace ⟦Enraged Warcry I⟧ in ⟦Fortifying Cry⟧)
2. ⟦Heavy Swing⟧ (Replace ⟦Fire Attunement⟧ or equivalent on ⟦Fortifying Cry⟧)
3. ⟦Precision I⟧ (In ⟦Herald of Ash⟧, after you got the extra spirit from Interlude 3)
4. ⟦Rapid Attacks III⟧ (Replace rapid attacks on ⟦Sunder⟧)
5. ⟦Prolonged Duration II⟧ (On ⟦Scavenged Plating⟧)
6. ⟦Rage III⟧ (On ⟦Sunder⟧)
6. ⟦Rapid Attacks III⟧ (Replace rapid attacks on ⟦Leap Slam⟧)
7. ⟦Rage III⟧ (On ⟦Leap Slam⟧)
8. ⟦Reinforced Totems II⟧ (⟦Shockwave Totem⟧, replace ⟦Font of Mana⟧ if you already have mana leech)
9. ⟦Cannibalism II⟧ (On any spirit gem)
Optional: Use ⟦Close Combat II⟧ on ⟦Shield Wall⟧ for bosses. You can remove Leap slam if you want and slot in ⟦Scavenged Plating⟧ instead of using ⟦Cannibalism II⟧.
WARCRY_NOTE

=== VARIANT 7 | Maps
[Equipment]
Crafting the mace
1. Grab any Mace with +2 or more to melee skill levels that has an open suffix.
2. Toggle Omen of the Liege + Omen of Dextral Necromancy, desecrate the weapon with a jawbone.
3. Unveil and hope for break armour modifier, use an abyssal echo if you want.
4. Exalt slam the mace until all modifiers are filled up.
5. Perfect Essence of Abrasion the Mace to get, gain phys as extra.
Crafting the Shield
1. Find a good base with highest tier of flat Armour and ideally with a good suffix, like fire resistance.
2. Slam Greater Essence of Enhancement
3. Toggle Omen of Sinistral Necromancy and Desecrate
4. Unveil inc% armour hopefully
5. Finish the shield by just slamming exalts
Leech: You want to make sure you can leech both Life and Mana, you can get this from rings or gloves. You can do without, but you might end up having to press your mana flask contantly when you get some extra levels to melee skills.
Crafting Gloves/Boots/Rings/Amulet
1. Find a good magic base with two good modifiers. - For boots you want at least 30% movement speed
2. Use either greater essence of opulence (if there's no rarity on the gear yet) or Greater essence of insulation.
[SkillGems] ⟦Ahn's Citadel⟧ + ⟦Kaom's Madness⟧ combo: These two lineage support gems significantly improves our clear when paired together and they are usually pretty cheap to trade for. Remove ⟦Magnified Area II⟧ if you have yet to find a Perfect Jewelers orb.
Optional: You can use ⟦Brutality III⟧ on ⟦Fortifying Cry⟧ instead of ⟦Heft⟧ if you have very little elemental/chaos damage.
If you get extra spirit on your gear you can slot in ⟦Berserk⟧ (and probably remove ⟦Attrition⟧/ ⟦War Banner⟧)
Optional: Use ⟦Close Combat II⟧ on ⟦Shield Wall⟧ for bosses.
Atlas rushing: At league start it's probably good to get Atlas points quickly before you invest too much time killing mobs in the maps. You can use ⟦Shield Charge⟧ to traverse maps quickly, it's faster than sprint and safer.
WARCRY_NOTE

=== VARIANT 8 | Giga Endgame
[Equipment]
Crafting the end game mace
NOTE: You do this craft AFTER you first get Uul-Netols Embrace, otherwise you can't break armour anymore.
1. Grab any Mace with +4 to melee skill levels and an open prefix
2. Toggle Omen of the Liege + Omen of Sinistral Necromancy, desecrate the weapon with a jawbone.
3. Use fracturing Orb (if it's cheap) and hope to hit +4 to melee, if you don't it's fine.
4. Unveil for increased damage against fully broken armour (I think it's guaranteed)
5. If you hit the fracturing orb, Exalt slam until you have 5 modifiers. If you missed the fracturing orb or if it's too expensive, exalt slam all modifiers.
5. Perfect Essence of Abrasion the Mace to get gain phys as extra. Hope to not remove the +melee skills or the desecrate
6. If you hit the desecrate, you can try to annul a prefix to desecrate again.
All other slots: To get the upgrades for the remaining gear, the crafting will be more complicated than before. So unfortunately we will just have to wait and see what new methods arise.
[SkillGems] ⟦Uul-Netol's Embrace⟧ is usually a very expensive lineage support, but if you get you no longer need armour break on your weapon.
Optional: You can use ⟦Brutality III⟧ on ⟦Fortifying Cry⟧ instead of ⟦Heft⟧ if you have very little elemental/chaos damage.
Use ⟦Close Combat II⟧ on ⟦Shield Wall⟧ for bosses.
Around the time when you reach maps, you can use ⟦Shield Charge⟧ to traverse with instead of sprinting as it is just faster.
You can slot in ⟦Berserk⟧ (and probably remove ⟦Attrition⟧/ ⟦War Banner⟧), ideally if you have some jewels that give you extra rage gain.
Make sure you have ⟦Shield Charge⟧ on weapon set 1 only for that extra attack speed with ⟦Rigwald's Ferocity⟧
WARCRY_NOTE
